fields.name: A Sweaty Cyclops
fields.location: [[Ab'Dendriel]], on the fourth floor of a tower past a small [[Rotworm]] cave located below the [[Wheat Field]] east of depot in [[Underwood]]
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Hum hum, huhum.|Silly li'l humans.}}
fields.notes:
A Sweaty Cyclops is [[Ab'Dendriel]]'s armorer. He lives in a tower north-east of the depot. His parents lived there before [[elves]] settled down there. Among [[Cyclopes]] he is known as ''Bencthyclthrtrprr''. Humans call him ''Big Ben''. You can reach him through an underground cave and ask him to trade certain weapons; however, he will not accept these items saying that they are not what he is looking for. He is a smith, so he knows a lot about steel and its kinds: Mesh Kaha Rogh, Za'Kalortith, Uth'Byth, Uth'Morc, Uth'Amon, Uth'Lokr, Uth'Maer, Uth'Doon and Zatragil. You can have him forge certain rare metals from common items, but only by providing the appropriate language. Looks the same as a [[Cyclops]]. To have him forge metals, you need to do [[The Sweaty Cyclops Quest]].
He is a part of the [[Koshei The Deathless Quest]], [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]] and the [[Obsidian Knife Quest]].
fields.history: He was implemented with update {{Update|6.2}} Part of a [[Quest]] to obtain a [[Fire Sword]]. This quest was later removed. With update {{Update|7.8}} he now reduces items to their material form.

Chartan is the leader of the resistance against the [[Awareness of the Emperor|Emperor]]. He sells [[Health Potions|Health]] and [[Mana Potions]] and some [[food]] and [[runes]]. He buys [[Empty Potion Flask]] and [[Vial]]s. There's no other way of obtaining [[Dragonfruit]] than through him.

She says that she rarely has to use her authority, as life on [[Feyrist]] knows few troubles.
Part of the [[Threatened Dreams Quest]].

'''Alyxo''' is an actress and singer who owns the Seaside Theatre.
The book [[The Medusa and the Blind Maiden (Book)]] is about her relationship with [[Narsai]]. Part of the [[Kilmaresh Quest]].

fields.notes: Part of the [[Kilmaresh Quest]].

fields.name: Maryza
fields.notes:
Her full name is Maryza Firehand, [[daughter of Earth]], from the [[Molten Rock]].
She deals in [[food]] and runs [[The Jolly Axeman Tavern]] together with her husband, [[Jimbin]].
You must address her formally. Use ''Hello, Maryza.'' When saying "bloody mary" to her you get poisoned, dealing 15 times 1 damage and get [[Broken Pottery]] thrown at you.
Part of the [[The Djinn War - Marid Faction]].

fields.name: Melfar
fields.location: [[Kazordoon]] [[Dwarf Mines]], ground level, west from the royal mailbox.

fields.name: Nezil

His full name is Nezil Whetstone, [[son of Fire]], from the [[Savage Axes]].
Nezil and his sister [[Bezil]] buy and sell [[Equipment]] to adventurers. You need to say "Hi Nezil" to talk with him, not just "Hi".

fields.name: Pukosch
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Lorry tickets! A thrilling ride deep into the mountain!}}
fields.notes: He is one of the [[Lukosch Brothers]] and can sell you a ticket for the [[Ore Wagon]] near him. Pukosh got implemented late in the test server for the [[Winter Update 2012]], after player suggestions.

fields.name: Pydar
fields.location: North of [[Kazordoon]] temple, past the many [[Fire|Fire Field]]s.

His full name is Pydar Firefist, [[son of Fire]], from the [[Savage Axes]].
He is the head [[Pyromancer NPCs|Pyromancer]] of [[Kazordoon]]. He knows a lot about other [[Kazordoon NPCs]].

He built the [[Paradox Tower]] that includes a [[Paradox Tower Library|library]] and a challenge on most floors to get to the next one. He eventually died but his ghost still guards the tower and will reward those who answer his mad questions correctly.
Riddler may have been the man, [[Porgol]], who was an apprentice to [[Arcian]] whom he betrayed. He sought to become a great necromancer and killed his master in trying to gain power.

fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: He tells about the rebellion of him and some other renegade dwarfs against the [[Emperor Kruzak|emperor]]. Looks like a [[Dwarf Guard]].

fields.name: Sigurd
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Hiho adventurers, get your runes, potions, wands and rods here!}}
fields.notes:
His full name is Sigurd Fireworker, [[son of Fire]], from the [[Molten Rock]].
He aids his brother [[Etzel]] the [[Sorcerer Guild Leader NPCs|sorcerer guild leader]] in running his little magic store. He will give you your first rod or wand, but just saying "wand" or "rod" isn't enough: you must say [[Snakebite Rod]] or [[Wand of Vortex]].

fields.name: Tezila
fields.location: [[Kazordoon]], [[Shops Street]], one floor below the [[depot]] to the south.
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Gems and precious jewels! Also a nice investment for your money.|Interested in some gems? You can enchant them if you are a druid.}}
fields.notes:
Her full name is Tezila Gemcutter, [[daughter of Fire]], from the [[Savage Axes]]. She is [[Ferus]]'s sister.
Tezila trades in [[valuables]].

fields.name: The Orc King
fields.location: His Throne Room, deep inside [[Ulderek's Rock]].
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Harrrrk! You think you are strong now? You shall never escape my wrath! I am immortal!|Blubb.|Yes, flee this place, but you will never escape my revenge!}}
fields.notes:
The [[Defiler]]-shaped King of the [[Orcs]]. His real name is Charkahn the Slayer. His appearance as a [[Defiler]] was caused by a curse casted upon him by a [[Djinn]].
'''Warning:''' The first time you say 'hi' to him, he will summon 3 [[Orc Leader]]s, 2 [[Orc Warlord]]s and 3 [[Slime]]s. A possible strategy is to stand on his [[Throne]] when saying hi (instead of running south), this way you can be melee attacked by a maximum of 3 creatures.
[[File:Orc King Strategy.png|thumb|300px]]
Part of [[The Djinn War - Efreet Faction]] / [[The Djinn War - Marid Faction]].
Part of [[What a Foolish Quest]], mission 10.

fields.name: Tulf
fields.notes:
His full name is Tulf Beardweaver, [[son of Earth]], from the [[Dragoneaters]].
He protects the emperor, despite being [[Drunk NPCs|drunk]].
Above him you may find 2 floors with 3 [[Dwarf Guard]]s and 2 [[Dwarf Soldier]]s in both rooms.

fields.name: Wally
fields.notes: Wally is [[Kevin]]'s assistant.

fields.name: Xelvar
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Talk to me if you're interested in adventure and excitement.}}
fields.notes:
Was implemented with update {{Update|9.6}}. He looks like a [[Dwarf Guard]].
He is a part of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

fields.name: Captain Max
fields.location: [[Liberty Bay]] on one of the eastern [[Boat]]s at the dock ({{Mapper Coords|126.42|128.128|6|4|text=here}}), and on a boat above [[Calassa]] ({{Mapper Coords|124.171|127.197|6|4|text=here}}).
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Whoah. That was a large shadow passing by.}}

fields.name: Captain Waverider
fields.location: [[Liberty Bay]] ({{Mapper Coords|126.88|128.87|7|2|text=here}}), [[Treasure Island]] ({{Mapper Coords|125.132|128.145|7|4|text=here}}) and [[Treasure Hunt Island]] ({{Mapper Coords|125.45|128.163|7|4|text=here}})

fields.name: Chantalle
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes:
She is a trader and sell gems, jewelry and goblets. She thinks that [[Liberty Bay]] is a horrible little town, everything and everyone that is native smells like fish. As far as she understands, sugar is quite important. She thinks that [[sorcerer]]s are horrible people.
Has a tendency to overuse the word ''horrible''. Part of [[The Thieves Guild Quest]], mission 6.

fields.name: Charlotta
fields.notes: She's the Druid Guild leader of [[Liberty Bay]] and a close ally of [[Eleonore]].

fields.name: Chondur
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Spirits of the ancestors, guide me.}}
fields.notes:
Chondur is the local voodoomaster, responsible for several enchantments regarding some of the inhabitants of [[Sabrehaven]]. He is like a father for them, and protects them from the evil magical influences of the [[Cultists]] that settled on the [[Shattered Isles]]. Part of [[Shaman Outfits Quest]], [[The Shattered Isles Quest]] and the [[Blessed Stake Quest]].
He can supply you with the [[Stampor (Mount)|Stampor Mount]] if you bring him 30 [[Hollow Stampor Hoof]]s, 50 [[Stampor Horn]]s, and 100 [[Stampor Talons]].

fields.name: Duncan
fields.notes: Duncan dislikes [[Liberty Bay]] and therefore lives in the rebel settlement of [[Sabrehaven]].Part of [[Meriana Quest]].

fields.name: Eleonore
fields.location: Central [[Liberty Bay]], up in the [[Silverhand Manor]].
fields.notes:
Eleonore is the daughter of [[Percy Silverhand]]. She has lost a very special [[Eleonore Quest|ring]], and may reward you if you find it for her. Even though she's in love with [[Raymond Striker]], she doesn't respond to Raymond, but to Striker.
Part of the [[Eleonore Quest]].

fields.name: Marina
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|You wouldn't keep a pretty lady like me waiting, would you?|Hello, come and entertain me for a while!}}
fields.notes: Marina has put [[Raymond Striker]] under her spell and now that she has him, she certainly won't let him go too easily. She spends her time looking pretty, as a very arrogant TRUE beauty like herself finds no time for a job. You can trade 10 [[Spider Silk]]s with her for one [[Spool of Yarn]], but first you must complete [[The Mermaid Marina Quest]]. She's also part of [[The Shattered Isles Quest]].

fields.name: Ocelus
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: Ocelus is peaceful [[Djinn]] who is fascinated by the sea. He also wants to meet the mermaid [[Marina]] but he is too shy to talk to her.Part of the [[The Shattered Isles Quest]].

fields.name: One-Eyed Joe
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: She is called One-Eyed Joe, from Josephina. She is a pirate assigned to watch a cursed entrance. Part of [[The Cursed Crystal Quest]].

fields.name: Polly
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|No talk to Shkiiiiiiip! CAAAW!|Meee! Here! Talk talk!|ONE, TWO, SHREEEEEE!|Shkip ish shtuuupid!!|Talk to meeeee! CAAAW!}}
fields.notes:
[[Parrot]]s can repeat phrases said by humans.
Part of the [[Treasure Hunt Quest]].

fields.name: Amra
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Welcome to the post office!|If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.}}

fields.name: Asphota
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Hammers, ropes, nets ...|Tools available here!|All kinds of tools - buy them here!}}

fields.name: Giri
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!|If you are interested in gems and beautiful jewellery, I'm your man!}}

fields.name: Haani
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Beds, chairs, decoration, flowers, instruments! Buy them here!|Furniture on sale! Don't miss the opportunity.|Furniture! Best prices in town!}}

fields.name: Isika
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Buy bows, crossbows and ammunition here!|Bows! Crossbows! Bolts and arrows! Buy them here!}}

fields.name: Jata
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Amati's blessings! Is this your first visit to Marapur? I can show you around a little.|I know all the world changes and the status the world is in. If you're interested, I can inform you.|Need some help finding your way through Marapur? Let me assist you.|Talk to me if you need directions.}}

fields.name: Nagging Naga
fields.notes: Part of the [[Primal Ordeal Quest]].

fields.name: Nekaret
fields.notes: | sounds         = {{Sound List|Too many eyes. Too many secrets.}}

fields.name: Nipuna
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|I'm selling magic equipment. Come and have a look.|If you need runes, this is the market stall for you!}}

fields.name: Ziyad
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|I'll show you the world during one of my carpet rides!|No better way to travel than on a magical carpet!}}

fields.name: Charles
fields.location: Western end of [[Port Hope]], on the boat.
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay, Oramond and Yalahar.|Ahoy. Where can I sail you today?}}

fields.name: A Beggar
fields.location: [[Lower Rathleton]], just west of the bridge to the [[Workshop Quarter]]
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: Part of the [[Dark Trails Quest]].

fields.name: Chavis
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes:
Chavis takes care of [[Rathleton]]'s poor.
Part of the [[Oramond Quest]].

fields.name: Eathar
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: He warns for the danger [[Tremor Worm]]s cause by damaging the factory.

fields.name: Edmund
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Gems and jewellery, antiquities, wedding rings!|Purchase a work of nature's beauty and men's art!}}
fields.notes: He is skilled at making watches.

fields.name: Elbert
fields.location: To the south inside the [[Underground Glooth Factory]]
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: Part of the [[Oramond_Quest/Spoiler#The_Glooth_Bandits|Oramond Quest - Glooth Bandits]] mission.

fields.name: Elliott
fields.location: [[Rathleton Sewers]], a bit north and one floor below [[Fillias]].
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|We're on a mission from above.}}
fields.notes:
He is a Glooth Brother of [[Jacob]].
Part of the [[Dark Trails Quest]] and the [[Oramond Quest]].

fields.name: Emily
fields.location: The Barbican, in the northwest of [[Upper Rathleton]], one floor up.
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Oh, my love. I know you are alive, somewhere!|<sigh>}}
fields.notes: Her name is Lady Emily Bafour. She is the mother of [[Graham]] and married to some [[Dr Merlay|Henry]] who presumably died in a [[Glooth]]-related accident.

fields.name: Fabiana
fields.location: The [[Rathleton]] [[Tibiadrome]]; access via [[Mystic Flame]] by temple in [[Rathleton Shops]].
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Drome fighters! You can trade your hard earned drome points here!|Fighters from the old arena still visit me to exchange their hard earned badges! Earned in blood that is... mostly.}}
fields.notes: '''Fabiana''' can exchange your old [[Arena Badge]]s for [[potions]] and [[Drome Points]] for some exclusive items.
fields.history: She used to be [[Helsi Van Ore]]'s assistant on the old [[Monster Arena]].

fields.name: Fayla
fields.location: Madame Feyla's Music Chamber, in the east of [[Upper Rathleton]].
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Do, re, mi, fa, so la, ti, do! <hums>}}
fields.notes: Her name is Madame Fayla Thibault. She gives music lessons, but is fully booked at the moment.

fields.name: Fillias
fields.location: [[Lower Rathleton]], next to the old [[Glooth Factory]]
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|What? What? Is there anyone there? Oh. Just the wind.|Shoo! Off with you, horrible pests!|Hah. It will all end in tears, you mark my words. <mutters>}}
fields.notes: Fillias Wayward Stokeston used to be the waterworks keeper of [[Rathleton]], but stopped because he was getting too old.

fields.name: Fyodor
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Letters! Parcels! Daily news!|If you need help with letters or parcels, ask away. I can explain the system.}}
fields.notes: His full name is Fyodor Bariton Fairfax. He is editor of the newspaper Oramond Observer. He will trade [[Blank Parchment]], [[Document (Rewriteable)]], [[Inkwell]], [[Parchment]] and [[Scroll]] if you say ''paper'' to him.

fields.name: Georgia Rainbird
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: She is a blind scientist. Part of the [[Glooth Factory Quest]] - ''The Mutated Glooth Plague'' mission.

fields.name: Graham
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Self-defense and combat spells, easy to learn for everyone!|Knight spells!}}
fields.notes: His name is Graham Balfour. His father died in a scientific accident which left his mother [[Emily]] Balfour, who is living upstairs, in despair.

fields.name: Guardian of the Deep Seas
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes:
He looks like a [[Crustacea Gigantica]].
Part of the [[Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest]].

fields.name: Guide Kunibert
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Hello, is this your first visit to Rathleton? I can show you around a little.|Talk to me if you need directions.|Need some help finding your way through Rathleton? Let me assist you.|I can inform you about the status of this world, if you're interested.|Free escort to the depot for newcomers!}}
fields.notes: Kunibert helps newcomers find their way through [[Rathleton]] by marking important places such as the [[depot]] and the [[bank]] in the players' [[automap]] and escorting new players to the depot.

fields.name: Hexel
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: He is overseer of the new glooth plant.

fields.name: Jossel
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: He warns for the danger of minotaurs and wallbreakers which might damage the factory.

fields.name: Klesar
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: He is a scientist ordered to keep the plant running smoothly.

fields.name: Kromrek
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: He warns for the danger of foreign creatures and a glooth bomb which might damage the factory.

fields.name: Maro
fields.location: Tool Shop, in the north of [[Upper Rathleton]].
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Hm.}}
fields.notes: Maro is a [[Minotaur NPCs|Minotaur]] and the toolmaker of [[Rathleton]].

fields.name: Marvin
fields.location: [[Rathleton]], in the entrance level (+2 floor) of the [[Rathleton Magistrate|Magistrate building]] on [[Rathleton Magistrate Plaza]].
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|The citizens of Rathleton voted for Bullwark/Glooth Fairy/Lisa.|The citizens of Rathleton voted for the shortcut back from the catacombs/fungi/minotaurs.|The citizens of Rathleton voted for the golems/minotaurs/wrath of evil in the dungeon.}}
fields.notes:
Marvin manages the voting system for Rathleton and confers citizenship ranks. What he says depends on what the players have voted on.
Part of the [[Rathleton Quest]].

fields.name: Nicholas
fields.location: Interior Design, in the east of [[Upper Rathleton]]
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|The newest items from Venore! Finest tapestries, lamps and clocks!|Hand-crafted timeless design from the very best in Rathleton!}}
fields.notes:
His full name is Nicholas Cavendish. He trades in [[furniture]], but also designs it himself.
Part of [[The Gloud Ship]] mission.

fields.name: Normod
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}

fields.name: Peremin
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: He worked with Prof [[Zeronex]] on a glooth powered flying device.

fields.name: Al Dee
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!|Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!|Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!|Don't head for adventure without a rope and torches! Buy your supplies here!}}

fields.name: Dream Butterfly
fields.location: Upper [[Roshamuul]], east of the central mountain
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Soothe, mend, dance, defend; ah, horror and fear, too near, too near.|Whirring, whirling, meandering, lost, lost, lost...}}
fields.notes:
Will curse you when you speak with it if you happen to kill a [[Shimmying Butterfly]].

Part of the [[Roshamuul Quest]].

fields.name: Eldoran the Ambitious
fields.notes: A descendant of [[Eldoran Etzel]].

fields.name: A Restless Soul
fields.notes:
In life he was known as Tylaf, an apprentice of [[Hjaern]]. He was tortured to death by the [[Cult]]ists but his soul remains.
Part of [[The Ice Islands Quest]].
The first time you visit it you can't speak to it so just take the paper and go back to the shaman, after being granted the power to speak you must say: '''story''' to it in order to proceed.

fields.name: A Starving Dog
fields.location: [[Svargrond]], 2 levels up, west of the [[Formorgar Glacier]].
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Sniff.|Munch.}}
fields.notes:
This starving dog is lost from its friend and owner, [[Iskan]].
Part of [[The Ice Islands Quest]].

fields.name: Baltim
fields.location: South part of [[Tyrsung]], north-west building (one floor up) in the village full of [[Smuggler]]s.
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: Baltim is the overseer of the Smuggler camp outpost on behalf of [[Venore]]. He says he does not sell wares, but he does.

fields.name: Bertha
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Hey there, need some general goods or paperware?}}
fields.notes: Come here to buy good equipment.

fields.name: Captain Breezelda
fields.location: [[Svargrond]], eastern part of city on her ship
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Passages to Carlin, Venore and Thais.}}

fields.name: Captain Haba
fields.location: [[Svargrond]], eastern part of city on his ship
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Is this a mutiny or what? Move, move!!|In the rigging ya lazy fools!|I wanna see you movin' ya lazy fools!!|Full sails!! There's a sea serpent to catch!!}}
fields.notes: Part of [[The Hunt for the Sea Serpent Quest]].

fields.name: Dankwart
fields.location: West in [[Svargrond]], in the tavern [[Tempest in a Meadhorn]].
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Come to my tavern if you're hungry or thirsty, traveller.|You'll never taste such fine mead and tea like here in this tavern.}}
fields.notes: Dankwart runs the tavern [[Tempest in a Meadhorn]].

fields.name: Eirik
fields.notes: Eirik is a [[Barbarian]]. He protects the town from outside dangers. Ask him about the town and any shops and he can tell you where to go and who to look for.

fields.name: Freezhild
fields.notes:
She is the leader of the [[Krimhorn]] [[Barbarians]].
Part of the [[Secret Service Quest]]

fields.name: Fynn
fields.notes: Fynn is a [[Barbarian]]. He protects the town from outside dangers. Ask him about the town and any shops and he can tell you where to go and who to look for.

fields.name: Janz
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Moved into a new house? I got the perfect furniture for you.}}
fields.notes: Janz sells [[furniture]], wall hangings, decorations, and more. Everything you might need to furnish your home.

fields.name: Jessica
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Gems, jewels... all a woman could dream of is right here.|Leave your money with me where it's safe!}}
fields.notes: Sells and buys gems and jewelry. She also runs the bank in [[Svargrond]]. She exchanges [[Gold Coin]]s, [[Platinum Coin]]s and [[Crystal Coin]]s. You can deposit, withdraw, and transfer money as well as checking your account balance.

fields.name: Kjesse
fields.notes: He can heal you and tell about the [[Blessing]]s.

fields.name: Lurik
fields.job: Local Representative of the Explorer Society
fields.notes:
Lurik is one of the few main land inhabitants who have gained the trust from the jarl Sven, and so some of the citizens in Svargrond will ask you to represent [[Svargrond]] with the [[Explorer Society]] to Lurik. [[The Northern Lands (Book)|The Northern Lands book]] can be found on the second floor of his Explorer Society building.
The CipSoft content creators put a little joke in his script. If you ask him '''name''' he will answer: "''My name is Lurik. Odd enough you ask though. People hardly do that nowadays. I feel as if my name was painted above my head or something.''" which is of course true.
Part of [[The Ice Islands Quest]], ''The Contact'' mission.
Part of [[The Explorer Society]], ''The Island of Dragons'' mission.

fields.name: Nelly
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Welcome to the post office!|Also selling runes, potions and magical equipment!}}
fields.notes: She will happily supply you with the [[potions]] you need for your hunts.

fields.name: Nor
fields.location: South in [[Krimhorn]], west of the [[Ice Witch]] tower
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|If you're caught or killed, I'll deny that I have known you.}}
fields.notes: Part of [[The Ice Islands Quest]].

fields.name: Rashid
fields.location: Travels around between [[Carlin]] and various [[Premium]] cities.

fields.notes:
[[File:Rashid_Big.png|thumb|right|300px]] You need to win his trust before selling any items to him. He travels to a different city everyday.

This [[NPC]] changes his location everyday.
On '''Mondays''' you can find him in [[Svargrond]], in [[Dankwart]]'s tavern, south of the temple.
On '''Tuesdays''' you can find him in [[Liberty Bay]], in [[Lyonel]]'s tavern, west of the depot.
On '''Wednesdays''' you can find him in [[Port Hope]], in [[Clyde]]'s tavern, west of the depot.
On '''Thursdays''' you can find him in [[Ankrahmun]], in [[Arito]]'s tavern, above the post office.
On '''Fridays''' you can find him in [[Darashia]], in [[Miraia]]'s tavern, south of the guildhalls.
On '''Saturdays''' you can find him in [[Edron]], in [[Mirabell]]'s tavern, above the depot.
On '''Sundays''' you can find him in [[Carlin]] depot, one floor above. To be able to trade with him, you must complete [[The Traveling Trader Quest]].

fields.name: Robert
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Selling weapons - as sharp and sturdy as you can imagine!}}
fields.notes: Robert does not like his job and wishes that [[Bertha]], his superior, would let him have a different job or send him back to [[Carlin]]. This is probably where you shall sell [[lootbag]]s. He buys much for the highest price in [[Tibia]] and not many players go there so your lootbag has little chance of being stolen.

fields.name: Romir
fields.location: North of [[Svargrond]], north-west of the [[Magic Carpet]] in a hut.
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes: He says one could call him a hermit, although he admits he enjoys some company now and then.

fields.name: Sinatuki
fields.notes:
A [[Chakoya Windcaller]] who is forced to live outside [[Inukaya]]. Apparently, she is [[Food|hungry]] and eats all of your [[Rainbow Trout]]s or [[Green Perch]]es when you talk to her in the [[Chakoya Language]], if you are carrying these sorts of fish.
Part of the [[Sinatuki Quest]].

fields.name: Sirik
fields.notes: Sirik is a [[Barbarian]]. He protects the town from outside dangers. Ask him about the town and any shops and he can tell you where to go and who to look for.

fields.name: Thorwulf
fields.notes: He sells some spells for [[Knight]]s.

fields.name: Zora
fields.location: South part of [[Tyrsung]], north building (one floor up) in the village full of [[Smuggler]]s.
fields.notes: Zora set up her shop, "Tools 'n Stuff," on behalf of [[Venore]] and hopes for a promotion. She used to have a bounty on her head due to her youthful activities (piracy). She does not like [[Carlin]].

fields.name: Albinius
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Walk in the light of Shaper wisdom!|Our ways are the ways of the Shapers.|Welcome, my child.}}
fields.notes: You can give him [[Heavy Old Tome]]s in order to contribute in the rebuilding of the [[Halls of Hope]].

fields.name: Dorian
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes:
Dorian is the leader of the [[Thieves Guild]]. He is a clear allusion to Oscar Wilde's Dorian in [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Picture_of_Dorian_Gray The Picture of Dorian Gray], who committed crimes for his beauty; this one does it for money.
Talk to him to start [[The Thieves Guild Quest]].

fields.name: Eclesius
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|I'm looking for a new assistant!|Err, what was it again that I wanted...?|Do come in! Mind the step of the magical door, though.|I'm so sorry... I promise it won't happen again. Problem is, I can't remember where I made the error...|Actually, I STILL prefer inexperienced assistants. They're easier to keep an eye on and don't tend to backstab you.|So much to do, so much to do... uh... where should I start?}}
fields.notes:
Eclesius is rather scatterbrained and paranoid, resulting in a loss of memory from time to time.
He is the main [[NPC]] in [[The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest]].

fields.name: Eddy
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.}}
fields.notes: A good NPC to buy furniture if you have a house/guildhall on [[Fibula]]. You must have a Premium account to trade with him.

fields.name: Markwin
fields.notes:
* Markwin is the ruler of [[Mintwallin]].
* The first time you say {{KW|hi}} to him, he will summon 2 [[Minotaur Guard]]s, 2 [[Minotaur Mage]]s and 4 [[Minotaur Archer]]s.
* You can talk with him from outside of the building, so you can avoid standing within the spawn. You must kill the spawn nevertheless afterwards since he will abrupt the conversation before you can say anything.
** You should not end a conversation with {{KW|bye}} or {{KW|farewell}}. He will answer "Go to hell! Burn!" and set you on [[burning|fire]] resulting in an overall loss of 200 hitpoints.
* Aside from a small group of outcasts, he claims to be king of all [[minotaurs]]. He has never fully recovered from an encounter with a [[Dragon]]. His son's name is [[Ian]].
* Protected by a large labyrinth, the [[minotaurs]] in [[Mintwallin]] have been largely undisturbed in their underground community.
* He wrote a series of five [[Book]]s, namely the Chronicles of Mintwallin [[Chronicle of Mintwallin I (Book)|I]], [[Chronicle of Mintwallin II (Book)|II]], [[Chronicle of Mintwallin III (Book)|III]], [[Chronicle of Mintwallin IV (Book)|IV]] and [[Chronicle of Mintwallin V (Book)|V]].

* Is part of [[What a Foolish Quest]], mission 10.

fields.name: H.L.
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes:
Reaching H.L. requires a long trip and used to be dangerous (in the event of [[luring|lured monsters]]). H.L. doesn't pay you incredibly well, but he buys many [[items]] that cannot be sold at any other [[Shops|shop]], although most of those items are more profitable selling to other players.
H.L. seems to be especially hostile to [[female]]s, in earlier times he even refused to trade with them. In earlier times, people only used to come to him to sell [[Scale Armor]]s, but when these could eventually also be sold to other, more nearby [[Weapon Shopkeeper NPCs]], he became more and more lonely. Another cause of this is that the [[items]] he buys aren't well paid for. For example, he buys [[Demon Armor]]s, [[Dragon Scale Mail]]s and [[Magic Plate Armor]]s for less than 1000 [[gps]]. He even buys the legendary [[Blessed Shield]] for a mere 650 [[gps]]!

fields.notes:

To get to Hagor, go west from the [[Panpipe Quest]] and then south to a large room with 4 [[Fire Devil]]s. Then go down the hole to the east of the room and down another level. Here you'll find Hagor.
Hagor will give you [[Key 4022]] if you give him a [[Roll]]. {{Infobox Transcript| ''Player'': '''hi'''
Hagor: Greetings, adventurer Player. What leads you to me?
''Player'': '''Morrin'''
Hagor: Ah, I remember that man. We made a deal, guess about what.

fields.name: Nemal
fields.notes:
Nemal is blind. That's why he can't read or write. He calls himself "wanderer". His father knew [[Gharonk]], a very strange language. He will reward you if you help him with a problem. To get to this [[NPC]], go down in the ruin in the [[Jakundaf Desert]] and go down 5 levels. Walk north and turn to walk south around a corner, watch out for 1-3 [[Bonelord]]s in the clearing to the left. Take the ladder up from this cave, then go north past an intersection until you arrive at a locked door. Find a nearby ladder and climb it. There you will find Nemal.

Since Nemal is blind, you can help him see by curing his blindness. The [[Potion of Regained Vision (Book)|book]] containing the recipe for the potion of regained vision is in one of the bookcases in the [[Desert Dungeon Library]]. Bring Nemal all listed ingredients to obtain [[Key 4037]]. {{Infobox Transcript| ''Player'': '''hi'''
Nemal: Hello. How are you? Maybe you can help me: Do my shoes have the same colour?
''Player'': '''blind'''
Nemal: Yes, I seem to be blind. But I am not sure - maybe the dungeons are too dark!
''Player'': '''potion of regained vision'''
Nemal: I heard of a potion of regained vision ... but I can't remember how to make it! Maybe you can help me. Do you know something about it?
''Player'': '''yes'''
Nemal: So, did you bring the ingredients with you, stranger?
''Player'': '''yes'''
Nemal: You seem to have them with you. Can you tell me, how many minutes I have to cook them?
''Player'': '''31'''
Nemal: Ah. It seems to work. But what are the words I have to speak?
''Player'': '''nalus murtu'''
Nemal: Thank you! NALUS MURTUUU! ... I can see again! To show you, how grateful I am, I'll give you a key. Be wise when using it. I can't tell you, where it matches, but ... take good care, it is useless without mental powers!}}

Part of [[The Paradox Tower Quest]] and the [[Demon Oak Quest]]. If you've obtained the [[Holy Tible]] (but, for example, lost it), he can allow you to get another for a 1,000 gold fee.

fields.name: Zebron
fields.location: In [[Venore]], two floors below the central [[depot]], eastern side.
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|Hey mate, up for a game of dice?}}
fields.notes:
He hangs around the [[tavern]] and offers a game of dice.
You can bet from 1 to 99 [[gold]] and if the dice lands on 6 you get 5 times your bet. You may also bet 100 gp for a chance to win a [[die]]. Similar to the main money gambling game, if the dice lands on 6 you win the dice.
If you want to play with him, you must say: "dice" - "money" - "(any number from 1 to 100)".
There were rumors that you can increase your chance to win a bet with him if you wear a [[Wolf Tooth Chain]], but it was proven false. The chance to win is 1/6, so you will lose money in the long run because you will only win 5 times your original bet on a successful roll (unless you play for dice and can sell it for more than 600 gp).
He has a cousin named [[Hugo]]. Part of the [[Kissing a Pig Quest]].

fields.location: In the [[Foreigner Quarter]] all the way north-west in the harbour. Also on [[Fenrock]] and on [[Mistrock]].

fields.name: Maritima
fields.sounds: {{Sound List|}}
fields.notes:
Maritima loves her fish friends, but is sad that the [[Quara]] treat them so badly.
Part of the [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

fields.name: Oliver
fields.notes:
Say '''pass''' and the destination to go through his gate.
Part of the [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

fields.name: Ortheus
fields.location: [[Magician Quarter]], north-west section one floor up.
fields.notes:
Ortheus is fond of [[Tea]]. Will you be the polite adventurer to bring him some?
Part of the [[Blood Brothers Quest]].

fields.name: Palimuth
fields.notes:
Palimuth works for the [[Yalahari]] to help run city services. Talk to him to start [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].
If you have a [[Vampiric Crest]] he will exchange it for a [[Yalaharian Outfits|Yalaharian Addon]].

fields.name: Peter
fields.notes:
Say '''pass''' and the destination to go through his gate.
Part of the [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

fields.name: Xorlosh
fields.location: [[Beregar Mines]], just next to the city entrance.
fields.notes:
He takes care of the mining elevator and other mechanic issues at [[Beregar Mines]].
Part of [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]]. He needs 3 [[Gear Wheel]]s to fix the elevator.
